description: This file defines a PHP trait named NumberHelperTrait in the namespace OrangeHRM\Core\Traits\Service. The trait provides a protected method getNumberHelper() that retrieves an instance of NumberHelperService from a service container. It also uses another trait called ServiceContainerTrait to access the container.

methods.name: getNumberHelper
methods.description: Returns an instance of NumberHelperService by retrieving it from the service container.
